evidence: Official API FAQ says U.S. API realtime quote access is free during promotion, which is not permanent-$0 entitlement.
The API combines Nasdaq Basic + TotalView and NYSE ArcaBook; these are venue/direct-book products rather than proven consolidated UTP National NBBO.
The FAQ itself explains U.S. trading is distributed across multiple exchanges and app/API values may differ because of the API's selected source mix.
Official OpenAPI exposes real-time U.S. stock quote data when active market quote permission is present.
Streaming examples expose independent latestPriceTimestamp, bidTimestamp and askTimestamp, which is technically useful for G9-B.
Official permission metadata says U.S. Level-1/Level-2 API quotes require purchasing quote permissions.
No primary-source proof found that the purchased quote is permanent-$0 consolidated UTP/National NBBO.
Current official developer documentation surfaced is for crypto trading and crypto market data.
The documented best-bid/ask endpoint accepts crypto trading pairs such as BTC-USD, not Nasdaq equities.
Therefore it is not a scheduler-callable U.S.-equity National NBBO path.
